readings.moment: Fräulein Lina came down into the kitchen (thirteen minutes to eleven by the kitchen clock)
Madame's piano began (two minutes to eleven by the kitchen clock)
the temple struck eleven, after which Lina was still in the kitchen
Madame's piano stopped (eleven minutes past eleven by the kitchen clock)
the hall clock struck eleven while the kitchen clock showed thirteen minutes past eleven

durations: The kitchen clock is a quarter of an hour fast (15 minutes ahead).
The piano played for 13 minutes, implied from 10:58 to 11:11 by the kitchen clock.
Rosa could not speak for a while after going down the stairs from the atelier.
whereabouts: Fräulein Lina came down into the kitchen at about 10:47 by the kitchen clock.
Fräulein Lina stayed with Rosa in the kitchen until after the temple struck eleven.
Fräulein Lina sat by the stove in the kitchen.
Madame was playing the piano from 10:58 to 11:11 by the kitchen clock; Rosa heard it from the kitchen through two floors.
Rosa was in the kitchen when the hall clock struck eleven and looked at her kitchen clock.
When the toast was due, Rosa went up the stairs to fetch the master.
Rosa found the master on the floor of the atelier, by his bench.
Rosa went down the stairs from the atelier after finding him.
Rosa says she did not touch the master.
